source.attribution: ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
source.resolution: Provider categorical overview: 562 by 562 pixels per 3-degree tile; approximately 594 m north-south spacing
source.interpretation: Selected original is the publisher's categorical overview, not the 10-m native grid. Antarctica and areas north of 82.75 degrees N are not classified by this provider. Provider object ETags are validators, not claimed full-file SHA-256 checksums. Extracted overview payloads and values have independently verified SHA-256 checksums. Publisher overview generation is not specified in TIFF metadata; representative mixed cells match native modes. Subsequent application aggregation uses explicit area-weighted mode, never averages class codes. Display aggregation uses categorical area mode with NoData; mixed overview cells suppress minority classes and are not a confidence estimate. Modern reference only: no historical vegetation, agriculture, climate or biome is inferred.

legend.name: Tree cover
legend.definition: Areas with at least 10% tree cover, including plantations and freshwater flooded tree cover; mangroves have their separate class.

legend.name: Shrubland
legend.definition: Natural woody shrubs under 5 metres with at least 10% cover; scattered trees have less than 10% cover.

legend.name: Grassland
legend.definition: Natural herbaceous cover of at least 10%, including pastures and grass-dominated savannas; woody cover is below 10%.

legend.name: Cropland
legend.definition: Annual herbaceous crops planted and harvestable within the reference year. Woody perennial crops use tree or shrub classes.

legend.name: Built-up
legend.definition: Buildings, roads and other constructed surfaces; urban green space is excluded.

legend.name: Bare / sparse vegetation
legend.definition: Exposed soil, sand or rock with vegetation cover no greater than 10% during the observation year. This does not identify a climate.

legend.name: Snow and ice
legend.definition: Persistent snow or glaciers, according to the observation-year source classification.

legend.name: Permanent water bodies
legend.definition: Water present for more than nine months of the year, including lakes, reservoirs, rivers and observed coastal water.

legend.name: Herbaceous wetland
legend.definition: Natural herbaceous vegetation regularly or permanently flooded by fresh, brackish or salt water; tree cover and mangroves have separate classes.

legend.name: Mangroves
legend.definition: Salt-tolerant woody vegetation in sheltered tropical intertidal shores and estuaries.

legend.name: Moss and lichen
legend.definition: Land classified as moss or lichen cover by the source; no climate or species is inferred.

relief: ETOPO 2022 v1 60s ice surface, northwest-light shaded relief, opacity 0.85
